name: Andaz Delhi
insider_take: This isn't just another Delhi hotel – it's a living gallery where contemporary Indian artistry meets world-class luxury in the heart of Aerocity.
whats_special: Andaz Delhi showcases one of India's most impressive hotel art collections, featuring over 1,000 pieces from local artists. The property's unique design incorporates traditional Indian elements like handwoven textiles and brass accents, while the rooftop infinity pool offers stunning views of the Delhi skyline. As part of the exclusive Hyatt Privé program, guests enjoy complimentary breakfast, room upgrades, and late checkout.
pro_tip: Book the Delhi Darshan package to get a complimentary city tour with a local guide – it includes visits to hidden gems that most tourists never discover, plus priority access to popular attractions.
dont_miss: The hotel's proximity to IGI Airport (just 5 minutes) makes it perfect for layovers, but don't overlook the nearby Sultanpur National Park – a birder's paradise just 15 minutes away. The hotel's AER bar on the 18th floor serves Delhi's highest rooftop cocktails, while their cooking classes feature recipes passed down from Mughal emperors.
pros: Contemporary luxury design with modern Indian cultural influences
Prime location in Aerocity near international airport
Exceptional dining venues with innovative cuisine
Hyatt Privé benefits including room upgrades and resort credits
cons: Airport proximity may result in occasional aircraft noise
Limited walkable attractions in immediate Aerocity area
